Government forms panel to strengthen film industry, Prasoon Joshi to lead

The Indian government, through its Ministry of Information and Broadcasting, has established a study group tasked with strengthening the country's film industry. Prasoon Joshi has been appointed to chair this group. The ministry has also developed model State Cinema Regulations for states to consider adopting.
